title: Tagging a teammate with @ in a Plan or to-do comment notifies them

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: @mentions exist only in feed posts (post_mentions, fanOutMentions in app/(main)/feed/actions.ts). A host who writes '@sam can you take the flyers' on a Plan to-do notifies nobody unless Sam is the assignee. Fix: a public.mentions table (source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, created_by) written on save, never parsed on read; mention nodes store ids, not names; the server re-checks the person can see the Plan before notifying; an 'item.mention' notification type. Owner ruling 2026-11-24: the hub is built inside Spaces and the Frequency team runs from its own Space.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
